cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Stay Until We’re Okay
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the relationship feels repaired, even if the practical reason for staying disappears.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't call the taxi yet. The bags are ready; we are not. Sit down, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I apologised for telling my sister about your debt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You named what you did. We haven't agreed what stays between us now. Let's finish that before we leave.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's already paid for dinner. We'll be late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell her 'We're running late.' Nothing about my debt. Then sit here and promise me tonight stays between us.
